newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as Wall Street rises.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as Wall Street rises.

text.p: UK shares rose on Tuesday, with the leading FTSE 100 index closing 33 points off its record peak, even as the British Government unloaded 257 million stg worth of utility shares into the market.
Buoyed by firm debt and stock index futures markets plus a rebound on Wall Street, the benchmark blue chip FTSE 100 index settled 23.0 points higher at 4,061.5.
FTSE 100 advancers led decliners by a margin of seven to two, but volume was relatively light, with only 721.0 million shares registered by 1641 GMT.
Trading in British Energy and Scottish Power, two of the stocks sold by the government today, accounted for about 17 percent of the trading volume in London.
